skills.name: orchestrate-research-platform
skills.description: Manage and execute development of this startup research and decision platform through the repository's central .orchestrator run graph. Use for project planning, PM decomposition, architecture/contracts, implementation, connector work, Faz 1–7 changes, code review, verification, integration, resuming prior work, or coordinating Codex/Cursor/Claude agents. Enforces full project scope, phase boundaries, evidence/citation/decision invariants, risk gates, and result contracts.
